technical_and_design_decisions: Use existing Spring Cloud Stream / Spring Cloud Data Flow test infrastructure and testcontainers for integration testing
Implement acceptance tests using JUnit 5 with Spring Boot Test support
Leverage existing CI pipeline (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI) for test execution
Tests will validate end-to-end functionality: module deployment, configuration, data processing, and output verification
Use Testcontainers for external dependencies (Splunk, Kafka, etc.) where applicable
Follow existing project coding standards and test naming conventions
Tests will be placed in the appropriate test source sets (e.g., src/test for unit/integration, src/acceptanceTest if separate)
assumptions: The project uses Gradle or Maven with standard Spring Boot test setup
Basic CI pipeline exists and can be extended to run new acceptance tests
Testcontainers library is already available or can be added easily
Each sink module and batch job has a well-defined interface and configuration properties
External systems (Splunk, Spark cluster) can be mocked or run via Testcontainers for testing
Development environment has Java 17+ and necessary build tools installed
Existing test utilities and helper classes can be reused across modules
No major refactoring of the modules under test is required
Acceptance tests focus on happy path and key error scenarios, not exhaustive combinatorial testing
Team has familiarity with Spring Cloud Stream / Data Flow concepts

activities.activity_name: Project Setup and Common Test Infrastructure
activities.activity_description: Set up common acceptance test infrastructure: configure testcontainers, create base test classes, shared utilities, CI pipeline integration for acceptance test stage, and documentation templates.

Design and implement acceptance tests for null sink module: verify message consumption, configuration options, and no-output behavior. Include test cases for various content types and error conditions.
Design and implement acceptance tests for rich_gauge sink module: verify metrics collection, gauge updates, configuration of metric names/tags, and integration with Micrometer/Prometheus.
Design and implement acceptance tests for router sink module: verify message routing based on headers/expressions, multiple output destinations, routing logic edge cases, and error handling.
Design and implement acceptance tests for shell sink module: verify command execution, parameter substitution, exit code handling, stdout/stderr capture, and security constraints.

Design and implement acceptance tests for splunk sink module: verify event formatting, HEC token authentication, batching, acknowledgment handling, and connection resilience. Use Testcontainers for Splunk mock.
Design and implement acceptance tests for throughput-sampler sink module: verify sampling rate accuracy, throughput measurement, reporting intervals, and integration with metrics systems.

activities.activity_name: Spark App Batch Job Acceptance Tests
activities.activity_description: Design and implement acceptance tests for spark-app batch job: verify job submission, Spark context initialization, data processing logic, output validation, and resource cleanup. Use local Spark mode or Testcontainers.
Design and implement acceptance tests for timestampfile batch job: verify file generation, timestamp format, scheduling/triggering, file rotation, and content validation.

activities.activity_name: CI Integration and Test Execution Validation
activities.activity_description: Integrate all new acceptance tests into CI pipeline: configure test stage, parallel execution, artifact collection, flaky test handling, and validate full pipeline runs successfully.
Document test scenarios, update README/test documentation, create runbooks for test maintenance, and conduct knowledge sharing with QA team.
